name: HYBRIT hydrogen-reduced iron pilot at Luleå
description: HYBRIT Development and its partners operated a shaft-furnace pilot at Luleå, Sweden. Following natural-gas reference runs, the team demonstrated direct reduction of ore pellets using hydrogen made by electrolysis with fossil-free electricity. The solid product was sponge iron for steelmaking trials.

date.label: by 2021-06-21
date.basis: The partners announced completed hydrogen reduction tests on 21 June 2021. The actual date of the first successful run is not specified.

events.statement: By 21 June 2021 the Luleå pilot had produced around 100 tonnes of hydrogen-reduced sponge iron using hydrogen made with fossil-free electricity.

evidence.locator: Lead, production paragraphs and Fossil-free electricity and hydrogen storage
evidence.supports: Reports test output at Luleå and the source of hydrogen.
Independent audit confirms the distinct 2020 pilot opening and 2021 hydrogen-reduced product.

date.basis: The contemporaneous announcement dates pilot start-up; the Commission profile identifies natural gas as the initial operating feed.

events.statement: The Luleå test plant began operation. Initial natural-gas runs gave the project reference material for later hydrogen campaigns.

evidence.locator: Direct reduction with fossil-free hydrogen, first two bullets
evidence.supports: Identifies natural gas as the commissioning and initial reference mode.

events.caveats: This event dates the pilot equipment in its initial reference mode. The scoped hydrogen achievement is placed at the 2021 demonstration.

date.label: by 2024-08
date.basis: The dated project summary gives cumulative output by its August 2024 publication.

events.statement: The project reported more than 5,000 tonnes of sponge iron made under the fossil-free pilot process across test campaigns.

evidence.locator: From iron ore pellets to iron with hydrogen, Pilot trials for direct reduction
evidence.supports: Reports more than 5,000 tonnes as cumulative pilot output.

events.caveats: A pilot campaign total. It gives no annual commercial throughput or later operating status.

earliest_record.rationale: The partners announced completed hydrogen reduction tests on 21 June 2021. The actual date of the first successful run is not specified.

links.statement: HYBRIT used the ENERGIRON variant of the HYL Zero Reformer shaft process for its Luleå pilot. It tested natural gas before demonstrating a hydrogen-only mode.
links.scope: Transferred HYL-derived shaft-furnace architecture and its adaptation at pilot scale.

evidence.supports: The supplier names successful ENERGIRON use in the Luleå full-hydrogen pilot.

evidence.locator: Direct reduction with fossil-free hydrogen, first three bullets
evidence.supports: Explains the installed ENERGIRON-type plant, initial natural-gas runs and hydrogen campaigns.
Classifies HYBRIT as an HYL-ZR hydrogen pilot and explains this named technology generation.

links.caveats: The link tracks the HYL Zero Reformer method, with the Monterrey 4M facility serving as an earlier dated industrial instance. The sources establish process lineage at this scope.
